{"metadata":{"description":"A floating peak/off-peak tide card for DeepSeek Harness: i18n (en/zh/ru), local-time windows, session cost.","id":"gh:1372793211","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-tidewatch","slug":"proDreams/dsh-tidewatch","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A floating peak/off-peak tide card for DeepSeek Harness: i18n (en/zh/ru), local-time windows, sessio"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ing peak/off-peak tide card for DeepSeek Harness: i18n (en/zh/ru), local-time windows, session cost."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Napkin Tools: DSH Tidewatch"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"## Русская версия"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A floating peak/off-peak **tide gauge** for the DeepSeek Harness web UI. It docks beside the compose"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"r and answers three
questions at a glance: which pricing phase is active right now, how long is left"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" in it, and how much this session has
cost."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The card follows the DeepSeek Harness interface language (English, Chinese, Russian), renders the of"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ficial
peak/off-peak windows in **your own time zone**, and formats money, tokens and clock times wi"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"th `Intl` for the active
locale."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> This is a fork of dsh-tidewatch by KhalilYamber (MIT), reworked for
> international use: a real i1"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"8n layer instead of hard-coded Chinese copy, a redesigned card, and a local-time window
> table. The"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" billing math and the session-projection structure come from the original project."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Phase at a glance** — an amber (peak) or green (off-peak) state dot with the current phase name "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"and a live
countdown to the next switch.
- **Tide line** — the header shows how much of the current "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"phase has already elapsed.
- **Window table in your time zone** — the official UTC windows mapped on"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"to your own calendar day, with the current row
marked; the tier itself is always decided in UTC (the"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" official definition).
- **Weekend and holiday rule** — Saturday/Sunday and Chinese statutory holida"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ys are off-peak all day, so the table
collapses into a single all-day row and the countdown jumps to"},{"id":"p8s7","text":" the next working peak.
- **Active tier rates** — cache-miss / cache-hit input prices and the output"},{"id":"p8s8","text":" price per 1M tokens for the phase you are
in.
- **Session tokens** — input, cache (read + write), o"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"utput and reasoning, formatted per locale.
- **Per-model cost** — expand the session-cost row to see"},{"id":"p8s10","text":" every model's tokens and cost; the total equals the sum of the
parts.
- **CNY or USD** — the defaul"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"t follows the interface language (Chinese → CNY, otherwise USD); switching is one click and
is remem"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"bered.
- **Real i18n** — the card follows the DeepSeek Harness language, ships English, Chinese and "},{"id":"p8s13","text":"Russian dictionaries, and
offers Russian as a selectable language.
- **Shell integration** — reads t"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"he `--dsw-*` theme tokens (light and dark) and prefers the official `StateDot`, `Tag`,
`Tooltip` and"},{"id":"p8s15","text":" `useDismissOnOutsidePointer` primitives, falling back to built-in implementations when a shell does"},{"id":"p8s16","text":" not
expose them.
- **Keyboard accessible** — the badge and the disclosure rows are real buttons wit"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"h focus rings, `aria-expanded` /
`aria-pressed` states and a `progressbar` role on the tide line."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- Node.js ≥ 20.
- DeepSeek Harness with the `dsh plugin` command (a `web` profile).
- Nothing else: "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"the price tables are built in, and the plugin needs no API key or network access of its own."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"> The badge appears in the web UI, so install it into the `web` profile."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` after installing; the tide badge appears to the right of the composer."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> **The npm package `dsh-tidewatch` is not ours.** npm hosts only an old copy published by the origi"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"nal author (1.0.6,
> 2026-08-22) whose prices and rules are outdated, and this fork deliberately sta"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ys off npm. Do not install it or judge
> current billing from it — use one of the options above."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Upgrade and uninstall"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"See CHANGELOG.md for the release history."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Upgrading from the original 1.x"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**2.0.0** adds the i18n layer, the local-time window table and the redesigned card. Billing itself i"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ds the i18n layer, the local-time window table and the redesigned card. Billing itself is unchanged."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Two earlier fixes are worth knowing about if you used the original plugin before 1.1.2:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **1.1.2 — V4 Pro billing.** The official pricing-page footnote (2) and the 2026-09-10 changelog st"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ate that V4 Pro API
service continues after 2026-09-14 **with its billing method unchanged** (furthe"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"r notice to follow if that changes).
The earlier build had followed a news-page reading that routed "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"`deepseek-v4-pro` to the Flash price from 2026-09-14
04:00 UTC, which **understated** pro calls by r"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"oughly 4.4× (cache miss), 7.3× (cache hit) and 3.3× (output). The
repricing boundary `V4_PRO_RETIRE_"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"BOUNDARY` is a sentinel again, so pro always bills on its own rates; the routing
branch is kept and "},{"id":"p22s7","text":"only needs the date filled in when an official one appears.
- **1.1.1 — three price eras.** Billing "},{"id":"p22s8","text":"now picks the tier from the call's own timestamp, and the `costUsage` projection
moved to `stateVers"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"ion` 4. Persisted sessions replay once after the upgrade, so calls made between 2026-08-16 and
2026-"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"09-10 are restored to the **first** peak schedule (they had been billed at the newer, lower rates). "},{"id":"p22s11","text":"Live billing
was never affected."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Prices are built in** and cover three eras (base price / first peak schedule / V4.1 Flash repric"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ing); V4-Pro uses the
official 2026-08-17 rates. Per footnote (2) on the official pricing page and t"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"he 2026-09-10 changelog, V4 Pro keeps
being served after 2026-09-14 **with its billing method unchan"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ged**, so pro always bills on its own rates and
`V4_PRO_RETIRE_BOUNDARY` stays a sentinel pending an"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" official date. **When the official prices change, update both
`lib/pricing.js` (billing) and the `D"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"ISPLAY_PRICES` constant in `lib/client.js` (display) by hand, and keep the
superseded tiers as anoth"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"er historical era.**
- **Model names**: `deepseek-flash` is current (V4.1 Flash); the aliases `deeps"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"eek-v4-flash`,
`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` and `deepseek-v4.1-flash` are all billed at the curren"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"t flash rate (see
`MODEL_ALIASES`).
- **Tier judgement is fixed to UTC** (the official definition); "},{"id":"p24s10","text":"the window table is display-only localization.
- **The holiday table is maintained by hand**: it car"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"ries the 33 Chinese statutory holiday days of 2026 in both
`lib/pricing.js` and `lib/client.js`; ext"},{"id":"p24s12","text":"end both copies every November, when the State Council publishes the next
year's notice (the parity "},{"id":"p24s13","text":"check keeps them in sync). Make-up workdays on borrowed weekends stay off-peak, because the
official"},{"id":"p24s14","text":" rule bills every weekend as off-peak.
- **The CNY display is a fixed-rate conversion** (6.67 USD → "},{"id":"p24s15","text":"CNY, matching the official CNY prices), not a live rate."}],"truncated":true}
